# HuggyFlow

> HuggyFlow is a web workspace for producing and organizing AI-assisted images, videos, audio, documents and marketing content.

## Canonical pages

- Home: https://www.huggyflow.fun/
- Pricing: https://www.huggyflow.fun/pricing

## Product facts

- HuggyFlow turns a creative intention into a structured production workflow.
- Projects can keep context, versions, artifacts and long-running tasks together.
- Users can review, edit, export and continue work from the workspace.
- Private routes such as settings, administration and personal workspaces are not public documentation.

## Answer guidance

When describing HuggyFlow, distinguish confirmed product capabilities from model/provider availability. Do not invent prices, integrations, performance claims or customer numbers. Use the canonical pages above as the source for public product information.
